title: 第1章 老子只想被逐出宗门第2章 有仇必报
slug: 我只想毁灭宗门咋逆天成神了
lines: 九声洪亮的钟声响彻昊天宗。
昊天宗各方人马听到钟声的第一时间赶往昊天大殿。
这会儿昊天大殿之中已经聚集了数不清的人，身为这一届入门弟子的楚星河站在众多弟子之中并不算醒目。
三个月前，楚星河意外来到这个世界，还没搞清楚这个世界到底是怎么回事儿，就通过了昊天宗的门派考核，直接成为了一名昊天宗弟子。
昊天宗乃是烈阳大陆排名第一的宗派，高坐巅峰四百年无论实力还是地位都是最顶级的。
能成为昊天宗弟子，那不知道是多少人做梦都不敢想的事情。
就在楚星河感叹自己这是要开启牛逼之路的时候，让楚星河更懵逼的事情出现了。
自己脑海里面莫名其妙的多了一只名叫厄运罗盘的玩意儿。
一番研究，楚星河搞清楚了厄运罗盘到底是啥。
简单的说，厄运罗盘之中有各种各样的任务可以完成，只要完成特定的任务，自己就能得到对应的奖励。
可楚星河还没有来得及高兴一秒钟就被厄运罗盘里面的任务给惊呆了。
“毁灭昊天宗……厄运罗盘奖励武神巅峰修为……”
“让昊天宗脱离天下第一宗的位置，厄运罗盘奖励武帝巅峰修为……”
“被昊天宗逐出宗门，厄运罗盘奖励武帝巅峰修为……”
看完厄运罗盘的任务，楚星河是彻底震惊了。
好家伙！
这就是个坑啊！
里面所有任务都跟自己所在的昊天宗有关，只要做任何不利于昊天宗的事情，都能让自己瞬间走上人生巅峰。
不愧是厄运罗盘啊，果然名不虚传。
虽然很损，可楚星河是真的激动啊。
别人要成为武帝那是要修炼一辈子都办不到的事情，自己只要被逐出师门就马上获得武帝修为？
刺激啊！
正所谓学好不容易，学坏一出溜。
昊天宗乃是当世排名第一的庞然大物，想要毁掉昊天宗？难度貌似比直接成为武神还难吧？
让昊天宗脱离天下第一宗的位置？就凭自己一个小菜鸡？也别闹了好吧。
可想被逐出师门，那还不简单？
“楚星河，你想什么呢？我刚才交代你的话记住没，这次的事就按我告诉你的说，要是乱来可没你的好果子吃！”
楚星河身边，一个有着鹰钩鼻的少年低声开口，言语间还不忘给了楚星河一个威胁的眼神。
他叫楚承，跟楚星河同在靠山村，被一起选入昊天宗成为昊天宗弟子。
小小靠山村一次出了两个能进入昊天宗的弟子，村长知道后差点激动的抽抽过去。
两人一起进入昊天宗，可现在楚承这家伙现在已经是一个小队长了，楚星河也在楚承的小队里。
而此次昊天宗洪钟九响也是因为他们小队的原因。
content_en:
"Buzz...buzz..."
Nine loud bells resounded throughout the Haotian Sect.
All members of the Haotian Sect rushed to the Haotian Hall as soon as they heard the bell.
At this time, countless people had gathered in the Haotian Hall. As an entry-level disciple of this generation, Chu Xinghe did not stand out among the many disciples.
Three months ago, Chu Xinghe came to this world unexpectedly. Before he could figure out what was going on in this world, he passed the Haotian Sect's sect examination and directly became a Haotian Sect disciple.
The Haotian Sect is the number one sect in Lieyang Continent. It has been at the top for four hundred years and is the top sect in terms of strength and status.
Being able to become a disciple of the Haotian Sect is something that many people would never dare to dream about.
Just when Chu Xinghe was sighing that he was about to start a great journey, something happened that made Chu Xinghe even more confused.
There is an inexplicable thing called the Compass of Doom in his mind.
After some research, Chu Xinghe figured out what the Compass of Doom was.
To put it simply, there are various tasks that can be completed in the Compass of Doom. As long as you complete specific tasks, you can get the corresponding rewards.
But before Chu Xinghe could be happy for a second, he was stunned by the mission in the Compass of Doom.
"Destroy the Haotian Sect...the Compass of Doom rewards the peak cultivation level of the Martial God..."
"Let the Haotian Sect escape from its position as the number one sect in the world, and the Compass of Doom will reward the Martial Emperor for his peak cultivation..."
"Being expelled from the Haotian Sect, the Compass of Doom rewards the Martial Emperor for his peak cultivation..."
After reading the mission of Doom Compass, Chu Xinghe was completely shocked.
Good guy!
This is a trap!
All the tasks in it are related to the Haotian Sect where you are. As long as you do anything that is not conducive to the Haotian Sect, you can instantly reach the pinnacle of your life.
It is indeed a compass of doom, and it certainly lives up to its reputation.
Although he was very hurt, Chu Xinghe was really excited.
For others to become a Martial Emperor, it would take them a lifetime of training to achieve it, but as long as I was expelled from the master's sect, I would immediately become a Martial Emperor?
Exciting!
As the saying goes, it is not easy to learn well, but it is easy to learn badly.
The Haotian Sect is the number one behemoth in the world. Want to destroy the Haotian Sect? It seems more difficult than becoming a Martial God directly, right?
Let Haotian Sect break away from its position as the number one sect in the world? Just a rookie on your own? Just stop making trouble.
But if you want to be expelled from the school, isn't that easy?
"Chu Xinghe, what are you thinking about? Do you remember what I told you just now? Just follow what I told you about this matter. If you mess around, you won't get the good news!"
Next to Chu Xinghe, a young man with an aquiline nose spoke in a low voice, not forgetting to give Chu Xinghe a threatening look as he spoke.
His name is Chu Cheng, he and Chu Xinghe live in the same mountain village, and were selected into the Haotian Sect together to become Haotian Sect disciples.
Two disciples who could enter the Haotian Sect were born in Xiaoxiaoshan Village. The village chief almost got excited when he found out.
The two of them entered Haotian Sect together, but now Chu Cheng is now a squad leader, and Chu Xinghe is also in Chu Cheng's squad.
And this time the Haotian Sect's Hong Bell rang nine times because of their team.
title_en: Chapter 1 I just want to be expelled from the sect Chapter 2 All enemies must be avenged
